shock_blindness: Extrapolation fails during exogenous shocks. During the 2022 super-floods, monthly price volatility rose 2.24x from normal.
sparse_markets: Markets with <24 monthly observations are refused forecasts by the FR-8 guard.
short_history_intervals: Calibrated prediction intervals widen substantially when history is short.
baseline_dominance: On certain commodities, naive or seasonal-naive models remain competitive with complex models, which is transparently displayed in the dashboard comparison table.
